checks.C_optical_witness_and_fixed_placement: both references verified on a train card

details.mixtures: Exact planned ratios. Unavailable tiers retain their planned positions.
details.A: A has no 1a/1b weight. 20 separate Stage 2a train appearance dry batches.
details.same_surface: Unweighted per-loss measurements. Candidate total uses weight 1 solely for differentiation acceptance. Native right/down pairs use the legacy ID and GT discontinuity test.
details.B: Real B model batches require an admitted non-curved train unit or a released curved unit rebuilt with p2 or later. B 1b optical batches additionally require a geometry-matched 12-case release.
details.B_render_background: B v2 optical adapter uses an observed-prior raster fallback. Native cache of legacy SHARP and LaMa F2 fields is unavailable in the new B units.
details.G: All three prior channels come from the dedicated v2 G reader.
details.R: Held-out views within training windows are used only for supervision.
details.GPU: flock held only during short CUDA chunks, up to 12 batches or about 15 seconds before yielding.
details.loss_support: Effective sampled pixel counts for balanced losses, actual valid-view pixels for mv, valid rays for occ, image pixels and pupil rays for bokeh, and native adjacent pixel pairs for same_surface.

supervision.L_occ_and_hidden_substitute: native K16 labels at one available focus; use the matching native K16 focus when an optical target is present
supervision.L_bokeh: an available optical RGB reference at the same frame, focus and aperture
supervision.prior_coupling: the old B 1b corpus supplied optical references on all of its supervised frames, so coupled availability did not expose this problem
supervision.recipe_and_weights: unchanged; the full K16 support count is reported independently from the configured four-ray training draw

F2_policy.source: observed RGB, 1c SHARP and DepthSplat estimates, LaMa, frozen SHARP and old A-color

native_resolution_L_occ.definition: L_occ uses the same hard front-depth prefix and equal per-branch averaging, on the original B label/prediction grid
native_resolution_L_occ.policy: B uses the full native prediction and intrinsics and keeps the configured four K16 pupil offsets; L_bokeh, zero aperture and C occlusion preserve their existing grids
native_resolution_L_occ.historical_continuity: Legacy 1b and 1c B used 2×2 mask unanimity. It made B reveal supervision largely absent. Interpret the three continuity controls with that historical implementation.
native_resolution_L_occ.formal_gate: every B 1b batch has occ_reveal + occ_block > 0; record each branch and leave reveal as diagnostic
native_resolution_L_occ.timing_boundary: preloaded inputs and K16, CUDA-synchronized objective plus one full backward; no weight updates

zero_branches.reason: sampled four offsets contain no eligible rays
